status_note: Технический контракт изолированного кандидата пайплайна для Harpy (Blender-этап 2026-09-28). Не художественная приёмка и не бюджет. Высота 42 uu, подставка Ø22×5 uu, размах ≤ 80 uu, капсула Ø26×48 — ПРЕДЛОЖЕНИЕ 04 §3.2 / §3.8 до GD-058 (AD-OPEN-09). Одна модель на три экземпляра (ART-008); различение экземпляров — точки-метки на подставке, выбираемые параметром материала (предложение до AD-OPEN-06). Кости поставлены по геометрии этого меша (открытые края частей, срезы, ортопроекции с сеткой), координаты в кадре исходника Tripo; builder переводит их тем же преобразованием, что и фигуру. Стадии atlas и build — CLI tools/tripo-pipeline: atlas.exclude_parts + atlas.normal_renormalise; build flow seated-parts (параметрическая подставка, крылья на костях рук, per-face ориентация по high-poly).

history.note: /1 (2026-09-28, previous_profile, kept unchanged as the record of run 20260928-blender-um-fbx-v1) named an external builder (art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-HARPY-001/scripts/build_harpy_candidate.py) because tools/tripo-pipeline 0.4.0 build_candidate.py was Medusa-specific; that run's manifest keeps build pending and the CLI refuses /1 (profile key builder). /2 (this file) expresses the same build contract for the CLI flow seated-parts (tool 0.5.0): the choices the script hard-coded are profile keys now (build, materials.atlas, meshes.*.mode, anatomy, weights.coordinates_frame, sockets[].target, team_color.mask). The CLI rebuild reproduces the /1 FBX byte for byte (docs/art-pipeline/evidence/t33-cli-build-2026-09-28/); the /1 atlas came from art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-HARPY-001/scripts/atlas_harpy.py (atlas.py with exclude_parts and normal renormalisation), now atlas.py options with the same PNG bytes

atlas.normal_renormalise_note: normal texels renormalised to unit length after the LANCZOS resize (Tripo's part normal maps are only 97.6-99.9 % unit length; upscaling overshoots); near-zero texels become flat (0, 0, 1)

exclude_parts.tripo_part_4: Tripo base: replaced by the parametric base of meshes.base (no textures, 04 §3.8); its 512^2 set would not fit the 2K atlas at native size

atlas.reference_note: no committed reference atlas for Harpy
atlas.size_note: figure parts: wings and head 1024, torso and legs 512, feet 256 = 4 063 232 px, fits 2048^2 at native size (cells cover 96.9 % of the atlas); 04 §3.2 proposes 1K for the helper (proposal, GD-058) — the UE import can clamp with MaxTextureSize 1024

scale.measured_from: base bottom (z = 0) to the highest vertex of the head part tripo_part_2 (top of the feather crest, source z 0.6027); the wing tops (source z 0.559) are lower
scale.seat: figure scaled uniformly about the source base top (source z 0.0395, base centre x -0.0003, y -0.0624) and placed on the parametric base top (z = base height)
scale.choice_note: 42 uu = upper end of the proposed 35-42 uu (04 §3.2, height includes the base as for Medusa/Merlin): scale 0.65696, span 64.2 uu (≤ 80), Tripo base at this scale Ø19.2 uu, so the Ø22 base leaves a free rim for the instance marks. The Tripo-stage alternative (scale by base Ø22 = Tripo base) gives 42.3 uu above a 3 uu base, 47.3 uu with the 5 uu Base_Sidekick — above the proposal. Decision stays with AD-OPEN-09

materials.note: Blender material of the atlas (FBX slot name); the parametric base has base_parametric.material

body.join: all parts except the Tripo base tripo_part_4

meshes.weapon_note: Harpy has no weapon (rig-contract parent_by_character Harpy = null); the talons strike (LungeAttack «наскок»)

base.footprint_note: Ø22 x 5 uu (04 §3.2 Harpy card Ø22; height of Base_Sidekick 04 §3.8). Tripo base Ø0.293 x 0.039 m (Ø19.2 x 2.6 uu at the figure scale) has four open contact holes under the feet (source loops r 1.6-3.3 cm); it is dropped and a clean parametric base is built (proposal until AD-OPEN-09 / AD-OPEN-42)

drop_parts.tripo_part_4: Tripo base (976 tris, open holes under the feet): replaced by the parametric base SM_Harpy_Base

base_parametric.azimuth_convention: degrees in the XY plane from +X counter-clockwise; -90 = -Y = the figure's front

clearance.note: every pip edge > min_m (XY) from any body vertex lower than band_m above the base top

pips.note: 3 sectors 120 deg apart, so for any yaw one sector faces the camera within ±60 deg. The talon tips reach r 8.4 uu (source r 0.127 x scale), the pips span r 8.65-10.45 uu on the flat top (r ≤ 10.6 uu). Pips are raised 0.04 uu with a 0.06 uu skirt (no z-fighting with the top); every pip exists in every instance, unlit pips take the base colour

channels.R: team band: side wall and chamfer (TeamColor, 03 С-11: team colour only on bases/rings/markers)

mask.instance_rule: InstanceIndex 1 -> centre pips (•), 2 -> outer pips (• •), 3 -> all (•••): lit = G * (Index != 2) + B * (Index >= 2)
mask.values_note: binary 0/1 per channel, so sRGB/linear vertex-colour conversion cannot shift them

preview_colours_linear.team_note: 03 С-11 hex converted sRGB -> linear: #E8C06A = sRGB (0.910, 0.753, 0.416) = linear (0.807, 0.527, 0.144); #9FC2D8 = sRGB (0.624, 0.761, 0.847) = linear (0.347, 0.539, 0.686). The Merlin/Arthur profiles list hex/255 (sRGB) values as 'linear'

tripo_part_3.select_note: the left socket's boundary component (37 vertices) carries a slit branch toward the chest centre through a non-manifold vertex (9 of its 37 vertices lie outside the 5.6 cm ring); only the ring within 5.6 cm of the socket centre is capped, the slit stays as in the GLB

open_loop_caps_note: open loops of the Tripo segmentation that single-sided rendering shows as see-through: the ankle opening of each talon part (a slit between the scaled tarsus and the talons is visible in the front close-up of the first build), the sole opening of each talon part (hidden in the base at rest, visible once LungeAttack/DeathSettle lift a foot) and the two wing sockets of the torso (hidden by the wing root at rest, can open when a wing is raised). Fan fill; every cap corner takes the UV of the loop corner nearest to the loop's mean UV (flat colour of the adjacent island, zero UV area: the first build mapped the fans across the loop UVs and overlapped other islands, raster overlap 0.67-0.71 in parts 3/7/8); corner normals along the loop plane away from the part. The neck opening of the torso (r 6 cm, tilted) and the head part's neck loop are not capped: a planar cap would cut the collar feathers; the head part covers them in every probe pose. Geometric repair, not art-accepted

weld.normals: corner normals are captured once after import as a float corner attribute and re-applied after the weld and the seat transform (custom normals are stored relative to smoothing fans, which topology edits change)

orientation.method_note: per polygon: a ray along +normal and one along -normal (offset 1e-4 of height) against the whole candidate; area where only the +normal ray escapes counts outward, only the -normal ray escapes counts inward; score = (out - in) / (out + in)
orientation.expected_note: measured on the Tripo GLB 2026-09-28 (headless probes): tripo_part_6 (left leg with the bracelet) score -1.0 with consistent winding -> whole-part flip; tripo_part_2 (head) score -0.415 with MIXED winding (123 of 2 847 manifold edges traversed the same way by both faces, bmesh recalc_face_normals makes it worse: 143) -> per-face fix against the Tripo high-poly (per_face_reference). Every other part >= 0.984. The Medusa lesson: inside-out Tripo parts are a retopology defect, not a reason to regenerate

per_face_reference.gltf_to_blender: (x, y, z)_blender = (x, -z, y)_gltf; node names equal to the retopology part names, no node transforms
per_face_reference.vote: face centre and every corner: sign of dot(retopo face normal, normal of the nearest reference triangle); majority < 0 -> flip that face
per_face_reference.smoothing_note: the raw per-face vote fixes the direction (ray-escape -0.415 -> +0.975) but leaves 274 inconsistent edges where thin crest feathers make the nearest reference triangle ambiguous; ICM (iterated conditional modes) with data weight = vote confidence and lambda 1.0 per inconsistent edge brings it to single digits (probe 2026-09-28: lambda 0.3/0.6/1.0/2.0 -> 24/6/5/1 edges, score 0.9995/1.0/0.9999/1.0)
per_face_reference.why: the segmented high-poly is correctly oriented (Tripo stage: no inversion before retopology), so it is the ground truth for a face whose own winding is not consistent with its neighbours

orientation.corner_normal_note: tripo_part_2 has 3.2 % of its area with custom corner normals against its winding already in the GLB
orientation.fix: flip polygon winding and negate the custom corner normals of the flipped polygons (as build_candidate.py)

armature.bones_frame: source: Tripo GLB metres, mapped by the figure transform; final: metres of the candidate (root only)
armature.placement_note: joints measured on this mesh in the source frame (work/parts-measure.json, work/probe/parts_*.png): shoulders = centres of the wing root open loops (tripo_part_0 (0.077, -0.069, 0.377) r 3.6 cm, tripo_part_1 (-0.075, -0.076, 0.377) r 3.8 cm); wrists = top 2 % of each wing (leading-edge bend, source z 0.550-0.552) lowered 1.2 cm into the wing; wing tips = outer 2 % by |x| (tips of the longest primaries); elbows at 45 % shoulder->wrist, 5 mm lower; neck = open loop at the bottom of the head part (-0.004, -0.095, 0.417) r 5.4 cm; ankles = open loops shared by the tarsus (tripo_part_5 / tripo_part_6) and the talons (tripo_part_7 / tripo_part_8); knees inside the front bulge of the feathered thighs (slice z 0.176-0.196, centroid (±0.086, -0.097)); hips and hip joints between the thighs under the torso (estimate); foot tails toward the front talon tips. The bird leg maps to the template as thigh+drumstick = leg_upper (hip -> knee), shin+scaled tarsus = leg_lower (knee -> ankle), talons = foot
armature.wing_note: rig-contract optional_extensions.harpy_wings: wings = arm_upper/arm_lower/hand of the base skeleton, no separate feather chain; the proposed leaf bones wing_tip.L/R are NOT added (open question 4 of RIG-CONTRACT, decided after video refs and the first clip)
armature.weapon_note: weapon is kept only to keep the 17-bone UM_HUMANOID_17_v1 set (validate_clip.py skeleton_contract needs all 17 names and the contract parent hand.L). rig-contract parent_by_character Harpy = null: no weapon mesh, no vertex weighted to it; it sits at the left wing tip as an unweighted leaf

weights.method: per part group: Blender automatic weights (bone heat, parent_set ARMATURE_AUTO) restricted to the group's bones, rigid groups 100 % on one bone, wings by the wing_span rule, the head part by an axis_blend; then cleanup
weights.band_note: wing bands widened after the first build (root 0.035 -> 0.06 and distance-based, joints 0.02 -> 0.05 source m): the narrow bands gave edge stretch 3.0x (arm_l_raise) and 3.5x (forearm_l_bend) in the low feathers under the shoulder/elbow
weights.smoothing_note: no edge smoothing of weights (Arthur build 2026-09-28: smoothing raised the probe-pose edge stretch on Tripo retopology)
weights.fallback: vertices the heat solve leaves unweighted get 1.0 on the nearest allowed bone (point-segment distance); counted per part
weights.coordinates_frame_note: source coordinates (Tripo metres) on the ramp / axis_blend axis (default z), mapped to final metres by the builder

groups.why: head, face and feather crest; the collar feathers of the head part hang on the chest down to source z 0.331 and stay with spine. Not bone heat: heat split the collar into spine-only and head-only neighbours (edge stretch 3.1x at head_turn 35 deg, first build 2026-09-28); a plain z blend below the chin (neck loop source z 0.417, chin ~0.43) is continuous
chest and back with the wing sockets: spine; only the belly edge above the thighs blends into hips

right leg (feathered thigh, shin, scaled tarsus) AND the tail feathers (Tripo put the tail into this part: behind the leg, source y > 0.005 up to 0.057): the tail follows hips, not the right leg; the rump above the hip joint blends into hips
left leg with the bracelet on the scaled tarsus

weights.wing_span_rule: the wing is a thin swept sheet (top view: a V swept back ~37 deg); bone heat is unreliable on it. Each vertex gets a span coordinate s = dot((v - shoulder)_xy, d), d = the horizontal shoulder->tip direction; joints project the same way. Weights: hand = smoothstep over wrist ± joint_band, arm_lower = smoothstep over elbow ± joint_band minus hand, arm_upper = the rest; arm_upper blends into spine within root_band of the shoulder joint (root_mode distance: 3D distance to the shoulder; the wing root sits in the torso socket; with the span-based root of the first build the low inner feathers 5 cm under the shoulder were half on spine and stretched 2.25x at arm_raise). Feathers hanging below the forearm/hand follow the bone whose span they are under, as the secondaries/primaries do

part_roles.tripo_part_2: head, face, feather crest, collar feathers
part_roles.tripo_part_5: right leg (thigh, shin, tarsus) + tail feathers
part_roles.tripo_part_6: left leg with the bracelet (inside out in the GLB)

anatomy.feet_sink_note: talons at most 6 mm into the base top (source: they sink 7.4 mm into the Tripo base = 4.9 mm at scale)

tail.note: tail feathers of the right-leg part behind source y 0.03 follow hips, no leg weight

anatomy.note: part roles named by the profile; the build also detects them from the geometry (report anatomy.auto). Front: the talon tips (front 25 % by -y) ahead of the ankles and the head part ahead of the body centroid; sides: tripo_part_0 (.L wing) on +X, tripo_part_1 on -X

instances.status: предложено (AD-OPEN-06 open: «H1/H2/H3» GD-030 vs «Гарпия 1/2/3» QA-102; carrier — base marker or HUD)
instances.carrier: base top pips selected by a material parameter InstanceIndex (1/2/3) on one base mesh; figure mesh and material identical for all three
instances.grayscale: pips light bone-white on a near-black top (luminance ratio > 10), so they read without colour; team colour lives on the side band (С-11)
instances.identity_note: InstanceIndex is bound to the fighter (fighter.id -> index), not to the actor slot, so death and return (Winged Frenzy) keep the same marks (ACC-014); binding is UE/gameplay work

team_color.applicability: AD-CNF-58 open. For Harpy the team colour sits on the base side band (UM_Mask.R), as 03 С-11 asks; no figure mask is made

ue.base_material_mode_note: vertex-mask: ue-import builds base_material from the base mask (team band = TeamColor, pips lit by InstanceIndex), parameters base_material_parameters; atlas-instance: the base uses default_instance
ue.instances_note: team_color.instances_linear (03 С-11 hex converted sRGB -> linear); on the figure material TeamColor has no effect (team_color_mode none)
ue.team_color_mode_note: mask: BaseColor = lerp(BC, BC x TeamColor, TeamMask.R) (proposal; AD-CNF-58 open); multiply: BC x TeamColor everywhere (Medusa T4); none: BC only. Harpy: none, the team colour lives on the base band (03 С-11)

base_material_parameters.InstanceIndex: scalar 1/2/3 (per fighter; dynamic MI or CustomPrimitiveData)
